title: Understanding Bandwidth in KDE
text: The bandwidth in a KDE affects the smoothness of the curve. A smaller bandwidth results in a curve that closely follows the data points, showing more peaks and valleys. Consider how each curve looks in terms of smoothness and detail.

title: Comparing the Curves
text: Look at the density plots and observe which one has the most peaks. More peaks usually indicate a smaller bandwidth, as the curve is more sensitive to the data points.
